create_dictionary_from_vocab_file: create a Dictionary from a vocabulary file using Dictionary.read_vocab with a path to the vocab file
index_sentences_with_dictionary: index sentences from a text file into word IDs using Dictionary.index_data with a dictionary and file path
limit_dictionary_vocabulary_size: limit a Dictionary vocabulary to a maximum size by calling max_vocab with the desired cap
filter_dictionary_by_min_count: filter a Dictionary to keep only words with frequency above a threshold using min_count
lookup_word_index_in_dictionary: lookup the index of a word in a Dictionary using the index method with an optional no_unk flag
